pgCapture.note: No change capture; polling or our own SSE from the outbox (PAP-303).

partialSync.note: Every list endpoint is its own partial sync; no shared shape abstraction.

offlineWrites.note: Persisted mutation cache plus our outbox works, but has no server-side ordering or checkpoint story.

permissions.note: Nothing bypasses the API, so PAP-34 RLS and PAP-59 can() are the only policy homes. This is the security ceiling the other engines are measured against.

bundle.note: Tens of kB, no WASM, no local database.

targets.note: Runs everywhere with no storage caveats.

selfHostLicence.note: MIT, no extra service on the VPS.

maturity.note: TanStack Query is ubiquitous; TanStack DB is young but MIT and now maintained in the same orbit as Electric.

ergonomics.note: Familiar, but instant local reads and live queries are ours to build.
